3: This library provides an easy to use and lightning fast text templating system
4: to use with C++ programs.
5: 
6: It was originally called Google Templates, due to its origin as the template

8: matching its community-owned nature.

25:

27:

30: This code should work on any modern C++ system. It has been tested on Linux

33: 
34: There are a few Windows-specific details; see the [Windows README](README_windows.txt)

40: environment.

45: like this:

50:

60:
